content: .{@-दानम्@} .²1 the gift of a cow. .²2 the ceremony of tonsure or cutting the hair; रामलक्ष्मणयो राजन् गोदानं कारयस्व ह <ls>Rām. 1. 71. 23</ls>; अथास्य गोदानविधेरनन्तरम् <ls>R. 3. 33</ls>; (see Mallināthaʼs explanation of the word); कृतगोदानमङ्गलाः <ls>U. 1</ls>; अतोनं गोदानं दारकर्म च <ls>Kau. A. 1. 5</ls>; (<ls>Rām.</ls> explains the word differently). .²3 the part of the head close to the right ear.
